title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth.

Your Role

As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models.

You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.

In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement L1VE’s finance architecture for Germany and Europe, with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability
  • Own integrated financial planning, budgeting, business cases, financial models, forecasts and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making
  • Build and further develop relevant KPI systems for Technology, Commercial, Product, Marketing and Sales
  • Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships, licensing models and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications
  • Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO
  • Manage and further develop management, investor and partner reporting based on reliable and auditable data and processes
  • Coordinate interfaces with Finance Administration, Accounting, Tax, Audit, Legal and other external finance partners
  • Further develop finance, reporting and governance structures, as well as the systems and processes supporting them

Your profile

  • At least seven years of relevant professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role – ideally combining experience in a demanding consulting or Big Four environment with hands-on experience in a startup, scale-up or growth company
  • Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modelling, forecasting and management reporting
  • Strong knowledge of controlling, business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options
  • Understanding of German commercial, tax and corporate law requirements, as well as experience managing external professional advisors
  • Ideally, experience in the media, entertainment, sports rights, streaming, subscription or digital B2C environment, including licensing and revenue-share models
  • Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage
  • Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments
  • Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership
  • Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English, as well as confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools

Why us?

  • You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.
  • You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.
  • You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.

Interested?

Please send us your CV along with a short cover letter or a few sentences outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Head of Finance role.
We look forward to hearing from you!

description:

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

We are seeking an experienced Manager Design Engineer - Facilities (f/m/d) at Black Semiconductor to provide senior-level technical leadership in the design, modification, and commissioning of semiconductor manufacturing facility infrastructure. title: Senior Functional Safety Engineer
description:

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

Join a motivating team of experts developing Electric Vehicle technology through innovative zonal architecture development.

This position is based in our Berlin office and operates on a hybrid model, requiring at least three days per week on-site.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and continuously improve the processes and technical pipelines that collect, organize, and present all traceable evidences required for Functional Safety release or sign-off reports (production and SW releases) across all FuSa domains (Dynamics, Body, Thermal, Energy, ADAS, Core).

  • Define quantitative, evidence-based release criteria for FuSa sign-off — including thresholds for requirement verification coverage, safety mechanism test pass rates, diagnostic coverage metrics, ASIL-graded open-issue limits, and residual risk acceptance.

  • Work closely with PMT to align FuSa maturity criteria to program milestones and gate reviews, providing per-domain risk profiles that surface gaps in evidence completeness and drive early visibility of domains at risk of missing gate criteria.

  • Coordinate with FuSa domain leads, test automation, SW FuSa, HW FuSa, and PMT to align evidence deliverables against release schedules, driving pipeline efficiency so that sign-off can be given with confidence and minimal overhead on technical teams.

  • Develop and maintain automated dashboarding that consolidates release readiness, requirement coverage, open safety issues, and post-release fleet safety performance — enabling data-driven release decisions and continuous calibration of release criteria over successive programs.

  • Establish and track post-release safety performance indicators — including field failure rates against safety mechanism assumptions and safety-relevant DTC rates — to close the loop between pre-release evidence confidence and real-world outcomes.

  • Coordinate with external suppliers and Brand partners to collect, validate, and integrate supplier-generated safety work products and SEooC arguments into the vehicle-level safety case.

  • Work closely with the FuSa Process team and VWG Central FuSi process team to ensure release processes align with ISO 26262 compliance expectations across Rivian and VW programs.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic, Mechanical, Software, Systems, or Computer Engineering (or similar).

  • Over 5 years of experience in the automotive industry (or equivalent), ideally at an OEM or Tier 1, with at least 2 years in functional safety, systems engineering, or release/program engineering roles.

  • Proven knowledge of ISO 26262, particularly around work product management, confirmation reviews, safety case argumentation, and evidence-based release assessment.

  • Strong experience with requirements management and traceability tools (e.g. JAMA, DOORS) and issue tracking tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence).

  • Experience defining quantitative release criteria and safety performance metrics, and building reporting pipelines or dashboards to track them.

  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Databricks, Tableau, Power BI); ability to present risk and safety performance metrics to technical and leadership audiences.

  • Good understanding of vehicle system functionality across multiple domains.

  • Excellent organizational and coordination skills; ability to drive cross-functional alignment under tight release schedules.

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills; ability to report clearly and concisely to senior management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with supplier safety artifact management — SEooC arguments and supplier-provided safety cases integrated into a vehicle-level safety argument.

  • Exposure to fleet monitoring, field quality data, or post-release safety performance tracking.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and data pipeline tooling; scripting ability (e.g. Python) a plus.

description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

About this opportunity

As our Head of Supply Chain, you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of our supply chain from Asia into our EU, UK and US warehouse network, driving operational excellence to support our ambitious growth plans.

You'll lead our entire supply chain operations from sourcing of raw materials and our cosmetic products to final delivery of orders at our customers’ door step. You ensure smooth procurement, manufacturing, and logistics processes via air and sea shipments (incl. import) to our warehouses and efficient delivery to our B2C and B2B customers. If you're a strong Operations leader, passionate about building efficient and scalable processes and enjoy solving complex supply chain challenges in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to have you on board.

Your tasks

title: Art Director Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind eine Performance Marketing Agentur mit einem großen Fokus auf Creative Design. Wir entwickeln datengetriebene Ad Creatives, Creative Strategien und skalierbare Produktionsprozesse für Social Ads, vor allem auf Meta und TikTok, und produzieren dabei über 1.000 Creatives im Monat.

Kurz zur Einordnung, weil der Begriff Performance Creatives oft ein bisschen unklar ist: Damit meinen wir ganz einfach Werbeanzeigen für Social Media, also Bilder, Videos und UGC Ads für Instagram, Facebook und TikTok. Für YouTube erstellen wir die auch, unser größter Fokus liegt aber ganz klar auf Meta Ads (Instagram und Facebook) und TikTok Ads.

Dabei arbeiten wir mit richtig großen Playern zusammen und begleiten sie strategisch, zum Beispiel Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli, Steiff, Gothaer, Finanzguru, Pixum und Olavson.

Jetzt suchen wir einen Art Director in Vollzeit, der bei uns die kreative und strategische Leitung übernimmt. Das ist für uns eine extrem wichtige Rolle. Du entwickelst nicht einfach schöne Designs, du entwickelst Creative Strategien, die auf Research und Daten basieren, bist ganz nah an unseren Kunden dran, bereitest Reportings auf und leitest unser Design Team.

Beim Thema AI sind wir extrem weit vorne. Unser Setup basiert auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield, nicht auf Adobe, und wir setzen einfach viel daran, jedem im Team richtig gute AI Prozesse an die Hand zu geben. Du kannst bei uns also super viel lernen. Wichtig ist nur, dass du in diesen Tools wirklich selbstständig arbeiten kannst.

Genau deshalb arbeiten wir zielbasiert und nicht nach Zeit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns ganz normal, und wenn du es schaffst, deine Prozesse smart zu optimieren, hast du neben dem Job auch einfach ein richtig gutes Leben.

Aufgaben

  • Strategie: Du entwickelst Creative Strategien für unsere Kunden. Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du arbeitest die Strategie dahinter aus, inklusive Kampagnenkonzept, Angles, Testing Ansätzen und Messaging

  • Research: Du tauchst richtig tief in Researches ein, also Zielgruppe, Wettbewerb und Plattformen. Welche Ads schalten die Wettbewerber, wie sind die aufgebaut und was funktioniert gerade auf Meta und TikTok

  • Creative Deconstruction: Ads systematisch zerlegen und verstehen, welche Hooks funktionieren, was Aufmerksamkeit erzeugt und wie man die Zielgruppe bestmöglich abholt

  • Reportings: Performance im Ads Manager analysieren, Learnings ableiten und daraus Creative Reportings und Strategy Präsentationen für unsere Kunden aufbereiten

  • Kundenkontakt: Du bist regelmäßig im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, führst Calls, präsentierst Konzepte und Ergebnisse und bist kreative Ansprechperson

  • Teamleitung: Du leitest unser Design Team (Grafikdesigner, Motion Designer, Video Editoren, Copywriter), briefst, gibst Feedback und entwickelst das Team weiter

  • Kapazitäten: Du stimmst Kapazitäten, Prioritäten und Deadlines im Design Team ab und sorgst dafür, dass alle Projekte sauber laufen

  • Qualitätssicherung aller Werbemittel, visuell und mit Blick auf Performance, inklusive Safe Zones und plattformgerechter Umsetzung

  • Du entwickelst unsere AI Workflows mit Claude, Figma und Higgsfield ständig weiter und trägst Learnings ins Team

Qualifikation

  • Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) in Art Direction, Creative Strategy oder als Creative Lead, idealerweise im Performance Marketing oder Agenturumfeld

  • Wirklich hohe Kreativität: Du entwickelst eigene, unverwechselbare Ideen, keine Copy Paste Ads

  • Sicheres Auftreten: Du präsentierst Ideen klar und überzeugend vor Kunden und triffst im Team auch mal Entscheidungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit allen gängigen Designprogrammen, vor allem Figma

  • Sehr gute AI Skills: Du nutzt Claude und Figma im Arbeitsalltag und arbeitest darin komplett selbstständig. Erfahrung mit Higgsfield, ElevenLabs und Co ist ein großes Plus

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Ad Creative Konzepten für Meta, TikTok o.ä. (PFLICHT, bitte im Portfolio zeigen)

  • Du kannst mit Zahlen arbeiten: Ads Manager Daten lesen, CTR, Hook Rate, ROAS interpretieren und daraus Strategien ableiten

  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein kreatives Team geleitet und Kapazitäten geplant

  • Strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, auch wenn mehrere Kunden gleichzeitig laufen

  • Du beschäftigst dich auch privat mit Social Ads, Trends und Plattform Updates

  • Sprache: Deutsch mind. C1, Englisch mind. B2

Benefits

  • Arbeite mit wirklich großen Marken wie Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli und Steiff, und zwar strategisch, nicht nur ausführend

  • AI Vorsprung: Wir sind beim Thema AI extrem weit vorne, du lernst bei uns super viel und bekommst die passenden AI Prozesse an die Hand (Claude, Figma, Higgsfield)

  • Zielbasiert statt nach Zeit: flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote first

  • Datengetriebenes Umfeld, jede kreative Entscheidung wird messbar

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du formst die kreative Ausrichtung der Agentur mit

  • Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft

  • JobRad

  • Mehrere Workations pro Jahr

  • Regelmäßige Team Events

Unser Prozess

Weil die Rolle für uns so wichtig ist, gehören eine Testaufgabe und ein Interview fest zum Prozess dazu.

  1. Bewerbung einreichen (CV + Portfolio/Case Studies)

  2. Kennenlerngespräch mit Gerrit (GF)

  3. Testaufgabe: ein Strategy Case (bezahlt)

  4. Interview: Du stellst uns deine Testaufgabe vor, danach sprechen wir über die Rahmenbedingungen

description:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

At Artificial, there are three primary sources of documentation we maintain:

  1. Client-facing product documentation for insurance business users (brokers, underwriters and operations teams using our platform)

  2. Our internal documentation site, which is our most heavily used documentation surface, built docs-as-code from the engineering repository and authored largely by engineers.

  3. Our public API documentation, owned and authored by our Integrations team from auto-generated OpenAPI specifications.

The below responsibilities break down how each of these three sources are to be managed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the client-facing product documentation (1) end-to-end: strategy, information architecture, standards, tooling and content quality

  • Own the internal documentation gap backlog (2):

    • proactively identify potential gaps and triage incoming gap reports

    • route each one to the best-placed author and chase it to completion

    • write the content yourself where you're the right author

  • Steward the internal documentation site (2) and public API documentation (3): set the standards, information architecture and editorial bar for content authored by engineering and integrations teams, and keep the publishing pipelines healthy

  • Interview engineers about new features as they ship, and demystify them for non-technical readers before anyone has to ask

  • Act as editorial reviewer on documentation changes, catching duplication, misplacement and unclear writing before it ships

  • Write and maintain the highest-value client-facing content yourself: core product guides and release communications

  • Select, build and run the documentation toolchain, including docs-as-code workflows (static site generators, CI/CD, review gates) where they serve us best

  • Design and operate AI-assisted authoring pipelines that raise quality and throughput without sacrificing accuracy

  • Build the contribution model: templates, style standards and review processes that let product managers and engineers contribute content you curate rather than gatekeep

  • Partner with the Integrations team on API documentation: raise the quality of guides and examples around the auto-generated reference without taking authorship away from the experts

  • Partner with product and customer-facing teams so documentation ships with releases, not after them

  • Measure whether documentation is working: usage, search behaviour, support deflection and client feedback, and act on what you find

  • Set the standard for clear technical communication across the company

About you

  • 6+ years in technical writing, documentation engineering or a closely related discipline

  • Preferably an ex Engineer who has stepped into technical writing / documentation

  • Demonstrable experience producing end-user product documentation, plus enough developer documentation experience to edit and improve API guides credibly

  • Hands-on experience owning documentation tooling, including docs-as-code workflows (for example Git-based authoring, static site generators, CI pipelines)

  • A portfolio or writing samples that show you can make complex technical material clear for both technical and non-technical readers

  • Used to working in a fast-paced, technological environment, with all the ambiguities this presents: flexibility will be needed

  • Confident in reading and understanding code and pull requests, so that you are able to identify where documentation might need adding/editing

We especially want to hear from you if you have:

  • Built or substantially restructured a documentation estate, not just contributed to one

  • Experience establishing contribution models where engineers and product managers write and you edit and curate

  • Practical experience using LLMs in documentation workflows, with a clear-eyed view of where they help and where they fail

  • Familiarity with structured documentation frameworks such as Diataxis

  • Familiarity with OpenAPI specifications and generating reference documentation from source

  • Previously worked in a scale-up environment

  • Come from an InsurTech, FinTech or other regulated-industry background

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

Today, a key part of delivery has no clear owner: problem framing before configuration begins.

  • On the customer side, there are rarely UX specialists - only domain experts and sponsors who describe needs as pre-formed solutions.

  • On our side, configured workspaces are built by Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) in our Transform team: experts in the platform, accountable for shipping to a deadline, but not trained designers.

  • Our Platform teams have design expertise but are often too far removed from individual implementations to influence the moments that matter most.

The result is pretty predictable: we move quickly into “how” before we are confident about the “what” and “why.”

Your mandate is to slow down at the right moment and make sure we’re solving the right problem - then help the team implement the best platform-valid solution.

This is a founding role. You would be the first Forward Deployed Designer (FDD) at Artificial, hired into an enabling function within the Platform team, with the mandate to define how the function works and to build it out. Later, FDDs would join the Transform teams in hands-on client roles: you’d take part in hiring them (with our support), then line-manage them directly.

Responsibilities

You would work closely with the Transform team and customers throughout discovery and delivery. In practice, that means:

  • Establish the FDD function. Define the operating model, the patterns, and the ways of working from scratch.

  • Grow and manage the team. Take part in hiring subsequent FDDs and line-manage them as they join.

  • Join customer + FDE sessions early (problem framing and discovery), not only at reviews once decisions are already fixed.

  • Translate requests into problems. For example, turn “we need a confirmation button before this step” into:

    • the user behaviour driving the request

    • two or three platform-valid approaches

    • a recommendation, with trade-offs explained

  • Prototype and test ideas quickly using the most effective medium (written specs, wireframes, workflows, or light code). We care more about clarity and platform realism than polished artefacts.

  • Provide credible pushback when the customer’s proposed solution doesn’t address the underlying problem.

  • Codify patterns and precedents so knowledge moves from individual memory into shared team infrastructure.

  • Level up the FDE team’s design instincts over time. You shouldn’t be the only person who can think about UX across the two teams; part of the job is coaching, so the capability can spread.

  • Use workspace signals (e.g. session data and call analysis) to surface risks early - before they become escalations.

About you

You are a designer who thrives in ambiguity and constraints, someone who can bring structure, judgement, and clarity to complex, real-world delivery.

You likely have experience in enterprise/B2B software where:

  • the design system already exists

  • the hard part is framing the right problem and navigating stakeholders

  • solutions must work within meaningful technical and organisational constraints

You understand technical concepts fluently. Part of the role would involve writing code (with plenty of LLM and human assistance) using our in-house DSL (Domain Specific Language). We don’t want you to be an engineer, but we do need you to be comfortable reading and writing some code, reasoning about how a configurable system behaves, and understanding what the platform can and can’t express, well enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers and to explain these constraints to customers when necessary.

You have managed designers. You’re comfortable with line management of a small team (roughly three to five people) and have hired designers before. Early on, you’d do this hands-on yourself; as the function grows, you’d manage the FDDs who follow.

Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features.

  • Taking agentic QC to production. Turning quality-control agents that check multimodal outputs against a customer's ontology from a research prototype into a dependable platform feature.

  • Design, build and operate model-serving and inference infrastructure for transformer-based vision and multimodal models

title: Regional Field CTO
Director of Enterprise AI and Data Strategy
Product Integration Engineer, Defence
description:
We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you.

WHY DISTANCE?

At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics.

There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA, Supacat, and Galvion, and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland.

THE ROLE

The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces.

Your core responsibilities include:

  • Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase.

  • Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit.

  • Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase.

You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product.

  • You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams.

  • New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs.

  • A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count.

OUR EXPECTATIONS

What we're looking for:

  • A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk.

  • At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts.

  • Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly.

  • Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software.

  • You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces.

  • Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial.

  • Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then.

It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level.

You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English.

DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED?

We process your application data only for this recruitment and in line with applicable data privacy law.

title: Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble
description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial FEA software (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal management and cooling solutions and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

À propos de Vinci

Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

Présentation du poste

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine.

Responsabilités

  • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe.

  • Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

  • Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

  • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

  • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d'événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

  • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Ansys, Abaqus ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en simulation thermomécanique — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique.

Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies.

Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client.

Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations.

Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie.

Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes.

Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants)

Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance de la gestion thermique et des solutions de refroidissement et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI).

Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d'Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l'électronique.

Parcours Go-to-Market : Passage préalable par des fonctions de pré-vente technique, d'ingénierie applicative (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique.

Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Ne vous contentez pas d'utiliser l'IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus.

  • Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux.

  • Collaborez avec des équipes d'ingénierie et de recherche de renommée mondiale, dans un environnement de start-up en forte croissance.

title: Director, Enterprise, France
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

We're expanding our senior commercial leadership footprint across France to accelerate growth across Airwallex's enterprise solutions. You'll lead the enterprise commercial organisation in France, combining strategic direction with operational sales execution across a complex, multi-product platform.

  • Lead and scale an enterprise commercial organisation of 30+ people, including three Enterprise Sales Directors, to drive performance, accountability and operational excellence across France.

  • Own France's enterprise KPI and total regional revenue performance, introducing the sales discipline, forecasting rigour and ways of working needed to support sustained growth.

  • Define and execute the enterprise commercial strategy across core target verticals, expanding market share across Airwallex's full platform, including global business accounts, FX and treasury, spend management, global payments and embedded finance.

  • Sponsor and help close strategic, high-value enterprise opportunities worth $2M+ in contract value, building trusted relationships with French C-suite stakeholders and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Partner with regional and global leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Solutions Engineering and Product to turn market insight into stronger GTM execution, product alignment and seamless enterprise client onboarding.

You'll work from our Paris, France office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 12+ years of experience in B2B enterprise sales within high-growth fintech, payments or enterprise software/SaaS environments.

  • 5+ years of direct people management experience, including experience managing managers and Director-level sales leaders.

  • A track record of leading a sizable enterprise sales organisation of 30+ people.

  • A personal track record of closing or sponsoring complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals valued at $2M+ ACV.

  • Experience leading sales turnarounds, implementing new ways of working and establishing high-performing sales cultures in scaling organisations.

  • Deep experience in complex, multi-product platform selling, such as cross-border payments, global banking infrastructure, FX and treasury or developer platform SaaS.

  • A pure commercial leadership background focused on revenue execution, pipeline growth and deal closing, rather than general operations or general management.

  • Professional fluency in French and English, and based in or willing to relocate to France.

Preferred

  • Commercial leadership experience at a leading fintech or enterprise SaaS company, such as Stripe, Adyen, Datadog, Snowflake, Cloudflare or MongoDB.

  • An established network of C-suite decision-makers across major French enterprises, technology scale-ups and multinationals, including CFOs, Treasurers, CTOs and Procurement leaders.

  • Strong knowledge of global banking systems, FX risk management, treasury operations, card issuing or embedded finance infrastructure.

  • Experience operating with high autonomy in fast-paced, matrixed and rapidly evolving environments.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're energized by change. Your grow happens in steps, not a straight line, and priorities shift as you learn.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

Learn more about your team

Enterprise Business is about more than closing deals. This team helps large, often multinational organizations solve complex financial challenges that go well beyond a single product decision — moving money globally, managing treasury operations, embedding financial services across borders, and replacing fragmented financial workflows with one global system built to scale. You’ll be helping customers understand what is possible when their financial operations work as one global system.

It's a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic thinking with deep product knowledge: comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and the kind of autonomy that comes from being trusted to create value, shape the deal, and move complex opportunities forward rather than follow a rigid playbook. If you want to work on high-consequence deals that genuinely change how large businesses operate financially, this is the place to do it.

title: International Expansion
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in French markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the French market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Ideally, you would be able to start by February 2027.

Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

Présentation du poste :

Vous êtes responsable de l'ensemble du contrôle dimensionnel chez Isembard France - de la programmation MMT (CMM) et du contrôle premier article jusqu'à l'analyse des causes racines des non-conformités et la préparation aux audits.

Vous construisez la fonction métrologie plutôt que d'en hériter. Cela signifie écrire les programmes de contrôle, définir les stratégies de palpage et de références, mettre en place l'étalonnage des moyens de mesure et décider comment les données qualité remontent vers l'usinage et vers MasonOS.

C'est un poste opérationnel, à forte autonomie, au sein d'une équipe fondatrice de quelques personnes. Il n'y a ni services cloisonnés ni passages de relais. Vous programmez, vous mesurez, vous validez.

Responsabilités principales :

  • Développer, programmer et optimiser les gammes de contrôle MMT (PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso ou équivalent) pour des géométries complexes et des tolérances serrées

  • Interpréter les plans, les cotations GD&T et ISO GPS, ainsi que les exigences de contrôle et de documentation spécifiques aux clients

  • Réaliser les contrôles premier article (FAI / EN 9102), les contrôles en cours de production et la validation finale des pièces pour l'aéronautique, la défense, l'énergie et le médical

  • Analyser les données de mesure pour identifier les tendances, les causes racines des non-conformités et les problèmes de capabilité, et ramener les actions correctives jusqu'à la machine

  • Piloter l'étalonnage et le suivi de l'ensemble des moyens de mesure (MMT, calibres, micromètres, pieds à coulisse, colonnes de mesure)

  • Tenir à jour les programmes MMT, les enregistrements de contrôle et la documentation qualité selon les normes EN 9100 / ISO 9001

  • Travailler directement avec nos usineurs et programmeurs FAO pour résoudre les problèmes d'ajustement, de forme et de fonction avant et pendant la production

  • Accompagner les audits clients et de certification, et contribuer à la certification EN 9100 de l'usine

  • Collaborer avec l'équipe logicielle MasonOS pour que les données de contrôle soient capturées et exploitées, pas simplement archivées

Compétences requises :

  • Plusieurs années d'expérience pratique en programmation MMT dans la fabrication de précision, l'aéronautique ou un atelier d'usinage

  • Solide maîtrise pratique de PC-DMIS et/ou Zeiss Calypso

  • Connaissance approfondie du GD&T (ASME Y14.5) et de l'ISO GPS, et aisance dans la lecture des modèles CAO 3D clients

  • Expérience de la documentation de contrôle aéronautique (FAI, AS9102 / EN 9102, inspection à la source)

  • À l'aise sur l'ensemble des moyens de mesure : MMT à portique, outils manuels, calibres, et équipements optiques ou de scanning

  • Capacité à tenir et vérifier des tolérances serrées (±0,01 mm et en deçà si nécessaire)

  • Fort instinct analytique - vous trouvez la cause, pas seulement l'écart

  • À l'aise dans un environnement rapide, à forte autonomie et sans structure établie

Atouts supplémentaires :

  • Expérience de la construction d'une fonction qualité à partir de zéro, ou de l'accompagnement d'un site vers la certification EN 9100 / AS9100

  • Certification GD&T ou qualification en management de la qualité

  • Expérience du palpage en cours d'usinage sur machines 5 axes et de la correction en boucle fermée

  • SPC et analyse statistique de capabilité des procédés

  • Expérience en atelier à forte diversité de pièces et petites à moyennes séries

  • Maîtrise de l'anglais

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Travailler sur des composants critiques pour l'aéronautique et la défense

  • Prendre en main la fonction qualité d'une nouvelle usine dès le premier jour, plutôt qu'un recoin d'une usine existante

  • Accès à des machines-outils de pointe, des équipements de métrologie et une automatisation en constante évolution

  • Participation au capital (equity) d'un réseau d'usines en pleine croissance

  • Opportunité de définir les standards de contrôle à l'échelle du réseau au fur et à mesure de notre développement

  • Culture de haute performance axée sur l'amélioration continue

À propos d'Isembard :

Isembard a pour mission de forger l'accélération industrielle. Nous permettons de fabriquer des produits plus rapidement et à moindre coût pour les industries critiques, en combinant des machines-outils de pointe, la robotique et notre logiciel propriétaire, MasonOS. Les composants que nous fabriquons sont utilisés dans l'aéronautique, la défense, l'énergie et d'autres secteurs stratégiques. Nous construisons un réseau distribué d'usines haute performance au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Allemagne et désormais en France. Notre site français est une nouvelle usine à Wissous, en Essonne, au sud de Paris.

Idéalement vous disposez d’expérience en gestion financière, incluant par exemple la gestion de trésorerie ou la comptabilité.

  • l'habitude d'utiliser des outils d'IA au quotidien 
  • l'anglais écrit, nos produits et leur documentation existent aussi en anglais

  • Des produits concrets, utilisés chaque jour par nos clients, dans un domaine exigeant (réglementation, sécurité).

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

We're experiencing one of the strongest growth rates in the French Tech ecosystem: we're targeting €10M ARR by the end of 2026. To achieve this, we need to triple the sales team while increasing productivity, and therefore the ARR signed per account executive.

Your Mission

At the end of your first year, you will have built a system in which the sales team has tripled in size and increased ARR per sales rep by 50% (from €400K to €600K).

To achieve this, you own Revenue Operations end-to-end. You sit at the intersection of Sales, Ops, Finance, and Product. You report to the Head of Revops and Head of Sales, your main “client”.

This is a A to Z hands-on role. You define the strategy, build, run, document, and iterate.

Responsabilities

Sales & GTM Ops

  • Own CRM (Attio): pipeline structure, stages, fields, hygiene

  • Define and track funnel metrics (SQL, win rate, cycle length, ARR)

  • Build deal workflows, pricing logic, approvals

  • Support sales with clean data, dashboards, forecasts

  • Instrument meetings, calls, emails, demos in the CRM

  • Define activity standards; ensure data completeness; provide visibility on activity vs results.

  • Implement compensation rules as the single source of truth; automate calculations, reporting, and payout exports; ensure numbers are clear, trusted, and undisputed.

  • Sales tools ownership: own and maintain the sales tool stack (demo platform, telephony software, call recording, integrations), ensure reliability, adoption, and proper usage across the team.

Onboarding & Delivery Ops

  • Structure deployment workflows (from signed deal → live)

  • Track time-to-live, blockers, and handoffs

  • Standardize configs, templates, playbooks

Billing & Revenue

  • Own contracts → billing → cash collection flow

  • Work with tools like Hyperline / Stripe / invoices

  • Track MRR, ARR, churn, expansion, cohorts

  • Ensure pricing is applied correctly (per site, per provider, per call)

Rev Analytics

  • Build weekly / monthly revenue dashboards

  • Track unit economics (ARPA, gross margin, CAC, LTV)

  • Surface issues early. No surprises.

Process & Documentation

  • Write everything down (Notion)

  • Create SOPs so the company doesn't rely on tribal knowledge

  • Make the org scalable from 10 → 100 people

This role is for you if

  • 3–6 years in RevOps, Sales Ops, BizOps in a SaaS / startup that scaled

  • Very strong with tools and wants to build from the ground up (CRM, spreadsheets, automation)

  • Structured thinker, you prioritize your task according to the impact on your yearly mission : scale sales and attain 10M in ARR.

  • You're structured, pragmatic, and execution-driven

  • You're comfortable working directly with founders

  • You care about data, but even more about things actually working

  • Fluent in French, Professional English

Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • MacBook provided.

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Recruitment process

1️⃣ Discovery call (30 min) with our Talent Acquisition Manager

2️⃣ Hiring Manager interview (45 min) with Robin, Head of Revops

3️⃣ Case study (1hr) with Alexandre, and Robin

3️⃣ Culture / founder fit (1hr) with Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

4️⃣ Reference check

5️⃣ Offer ! 🎉

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Mixed-signal IC Design Engineer
description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out.

Responsibilities

  • Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic.

  • Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others.

  • Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements.

  • Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out.

  • Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance.

  • Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths.

  • Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments.

  • Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs.

  • Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus.

  • Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

title: Mixed-signal Verification Engineer
description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer you will own the methodology, planning, and execution of mixed-signal verification for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago's Systems-on-Chip, working across analog, RTL, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure correct integration and drive verification to sign-off.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience in ASIC or SoC verification.

  • Experience verifying mixed-signal blocks or digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital interfaces.

  • Experience with AMS (analog-mixed-signal) co-simulation flow, and setting up mixed-signal testbenches.

  • Strong SystemVerilog skills and practical experience with UVM or an equivalent verification methodology.

  • Experience building verification environments and developing tests, assertions, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Good understanding of both digital design fundamentals and basic analog/mixed-signal concepts.

  • Strong debugging skills, including the ability to investigate issues spanning RTL, models, clocks, resets, configuration, and analog behavior.

  • Experience with scripting and automation, preferably Python, Tcl, shell, or similar.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own the mixed-signal verification methodology and verification plan for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago SoCs.

  • Build and maintain verification environments at block, subsystem, and SoC level.

  • Develop tests, assertions, checkers, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Verify digital control and configuration of analog/mixed-signal circuitry across normal operation, corner cases, and error conditions.

  • Run regressions, analyze coverage, debug failures, and drive verification to sign-off.

  • Develop or integrate behavioral and real-number models needed for efficient mixed-signal simulation.

  • Work closely with analog, RTL, architecture, firmware, and SoC verification teams to identify and resolve interface issues.

Nice to have

  • Verification experience with complex high-speed interface IP such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, UCIe, SerDes, USB, CXL, or similar PHY-based interfaces.

  • Experience verifying interface initialization, link training, calibration, adaptation, clocking, power-state transitions, or other digital/analog control loops.

  • Experience with real-number modeling, SystemVerilog RNM, wreal, Verilog-AMS, or equivalent mixed-signal verification techniques.

  • Experience developing or integrating behavioral models of analog/PHY components into digital verification environments.

  • Experience with SoC-level integration and verification of complex interface IP.

  • Experience with low-power verification, power-state management, or UPF.

  • Experience driving a complex IP or SoC verification effort through coverage closure and tape-out.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.
